review.official:
Former
Bolívarian
military, Dobermann joined
Rhodes Island
as a drill instructor, primarily training entry-level
Operators
. She also assists with prisoner interrogation when necessary.
Proficient in military operations of various scales, Dobermann is a highly disciplined soldier and often leads the charge in battle as a guard.

files.description:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 14% 
Operator Dobermann currently showed no conspicuous symptoms of infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.26u/L 
Infection still in early stages, no apparent threat to physical health detected as yet.

A stone-faced drill instructor. 
Every new Operator joining Rhodes Island must endure Dobermann's 'welcome,' regardless of what glorious background they may come from. Even the rowdiest, most unruly recruit falls in line after her boot camp.

Dobermann isn't the only drill instructor at Rhodes Island. She oversees a squad of well-trained instructors in charge of various lessons and drills. 
Nearly all of these officers were once low-level Operators taught by Dobermann herself and hand-picked through a rigorous process. It's not an exaggeration to say they have the island's future on their shoulders.

A career military woman, Dobermann is heavy on discipline. There are many strict rules under her training regimen and no transgression or violation is tolerated, which has put off many Operators. 
At the same time, however, Dobermann cares about each Operator's diet, physical condition and even emotional state. She has never forced anyone to do more than what they were capable of doing. It's just that her commitment is a bit too subtle. 
Naturally, this stems from Dobermann's inability to properly express herself. Hopefully more people will come to understand her.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, are the new recruits keeping up with my basic training regimen?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A balanced, regular diet is also an important part of daily training. Any complainers get fifty laps around the deck.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: As a military instructor, it's important to achieve the perfect balance between strictness and leniency. To be honest... I may be a bit too hard on Fang...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When putting your Operators into squads, it's crucial to assign them positions where they can exercise their skills to the fullest. It's true that Operators' ability is important, what's really being tested here is your judgement.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, when training Operators, you need to work on spiritual fulfillment as much as improving their physiques and skills. After all, they need to be mentally strong enough to survive interrogations and all sorts of attacks on their minds.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You're looking for the newbies? They're training out on the deck. Yes, I do realize what the weather's like right now. Of course I do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Anomalies... ha. You can never fool the eyes of the 'Hound'.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you believe that command allows you to slack off whenever you want, then I WILL correct your misconception, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If I hope to remain at your side through all the difficulties to come, I must be even harder on myself. After all, with the world around us being what it is... the only way we can keep it together is to keep training our mental strength.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No slacking off!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Attention! I am Dobermann, former military instructor for the Bolívarian armed forces. Now, let's cut to the chase. Hand over the list of Operators in need of training.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This is how our training pays off.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion, huh? Thanks. I'm just doing my job.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The responsibility for training the future of Rhodes Island is on my shoulders. I will do my best to be worthy of that responsibility.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Then show me the briefing docs for the mission.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Calling all hands. This is not a drill!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Time to interrogate.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Orders?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Commence tracking.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Filthy scum.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Take that!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Tear 'em up!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hang in there!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter the challenges we face, strong fundamental combat skills can mean the difference between life and death.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Come back when you're less mediocre.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The operation was successful, but we still have room for improvement.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We have failed. I am the one to blame.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The newbies are intimidated by me, you say? That's only natural.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Please mind your behavior.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You want to cheer me up? Hm, let me interrogate someone, then.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Whether a workday or a holiday, I'm always on standby. You should keep your guard up too, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Today is a day worth celebrating, but nevertheless, I'll have to ask you focus on work before this evening's birthday party. Sorry, please forget everything I said about 'birthday party.'

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I always feel a sense of pride, watching as the novices grow step by step. Of course, I don't view that as a contribution to Rhodes Island, but I do walk together with them. Doctor. Never forget your calling, on the road to come.
